entities.summary: Ritesh Agarwal is an Indian billionaire entrepreneur and the founder and CEO of PRISM, a hospitality chain. He has been a panellist on Shark Tank India  in 2024. Agarwal listed among Top 10 youngest Indian billionaires in Hurun Rich List of India 2024, with a net worth of $225 million.
